title: ר' פפייס

paragraphs: R' Pappias. Yuhasin writes [in the chronological section]: It appears in Eduyot 7:6 [Heilprin reads כ״ז] and Temurah (Mishnah 1, chapter 3) that he lived after the destruction. In Shekalim chapter 4, Mishnah 5, he is in dispute with R’ Yehoshua and R’ Eliezer [Heilprin’s wording], and testified: ‘We had a cow, a peace-offering; we ate it at Pesah, and its offspring as a peace-offering at the Festival.’ If this testimony had been during the Temple period, they could have asked the priests. Rather, he testified after the destruction about what he had seen during the Temple period. See Rosh Hashanah 6, end of a. In Eduyot he disagrees with R' Yohanan ben Bag Bag. In Shekalim פ״ר [provisionally chapter 4; locator unresolved] he disagrees with R' Akiva. He testified in Mishnah Nazir 3:2 [Heilprin cites the beginning of chapter 4]. In Beitzah 29b: ‘in the name of R' Pappias and R’ Yehudah ben Beteira.’ See Part I, year 3722, where he was placed in the time of Shemaya, Avtalyon, and R' Yehudah ben Beteira. This is not so, for he was in the time of R' Eliezer and R' Yehoshua, long after Shemaya. He was an expositor: ‘R' Pappias expounded,’ etc., and R' Akiva told him, ‘Enough!’ Bereshit Rabbah 21:5: “R’ Pappias expounded” [the midrash reads Pappos]. ‘It was taught in R' Pappias's name’: Helek, 94a.
